items.title: 5.5 Surface tension of liquids (liquids ki surface tension) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.5, printed pages 103-104.

blocks.text: Surface tension liquids ki woh property hai jo liquid ke surface ke saath lagne wali force ko batati hai; is force ki wajah se surface ek elastic (lachakdar) sheet ki tarah behave karta hai. Yeh force surface ke molecules ke darmiyan intermolecular forces se paida hoti hai.

Surface ke molecules ko intermolecular forces kul mila kar andar ki taraf khinchti hain, is liye surface par ek "skin" (jhilli) si ban jati hai. Surface tension ki wajah se liquid apna surface area kam se kam rakhna chahta hai; isi liye droplets (qatre) sphere (gol) bante hain. Capillary action, wetting (cheezon ka geela hona), aur droplets aur bubbles (bulbule) ka banna, sab par surface tension ka asar hai. Machhar (mosquito) pani ki zyada surface tension ki wajah se pani par khara reh sakta hai.
Factors Affecting Surface Tension (surface tension par asar karne wale factors)

items: Temperature: temperature barhne se surface tension aam taur par kam hoti hai (molecules tez hilte hain, attraction kamzor parti hai).
Intermolecular forces: jitni mazboot intermolecular forces, utni zyada surface tension.

blocks.caption: Table 5.3 20 °C par kuch liquids ki surface tension (N m⁻¹)

blocks.text: Table mein ‘γ’ (gamma) ki values 10⁻³ (yani 1/1000) ki multiple hain. Maslan 20 °C par pani (H₂O) ki γ = 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹, ya 72.75 dynes cm⁻¹.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Table mein pani ki surface tension (72.75) baqi sab se taqreeban teen guna hai, kyunke pani ke molecules aapas mein hydrogen bonds se mazbooti se jure hain. Quick Check 5.5 (a), jo surface tension ke bare mein hai, kitab topic 5.6.1 ke baad chhapti hai; us ka jawab wahin hai.

items: Surface tension (γ, N m⁻¹): surface ke molecules par andar ki taraf net force, jis se surface elastic sheet jaisa; droplets gol, capillary action, wetting, bubbles.
Temperature barhe to kam, intermolecular forces mazboot hon to zyada (pani 72.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹, ethanol 22.75 × 10⁻³ N m⁻¹).
